The three routes reuse ai.enablement.read and ai.enablement.manage; PUT takes the tenant lock, expected_revision (409 when stale, TH09), an operation receipt (exact retry, changed payload 409, TH08) and a closed DTO whose total of 100 and whole numbers are checked by the server; forged fields are refused (TH03); audited ai_ranking_weights.changed. Weights are a preference changed by any manage holder without review, so a manager can steer which opportunity ranks first; this needs no new threat because it changes no official number, access or data flow and is audited. Weights that do not read back are reported UNREADABLE and block ranking (fail closed). The ranking makes no model or provider call. The generated FINANCE bundle is exactly ai.enablement.read, notifications.read and uploads.read (unit test: no write capability); with it a member reads the catalogue, saved plans, the policy, human-advice cases it takes part in and the ranking, and is refused every weights change (403, recorded denial; test_operations_head_reads_the_ranking_but_cannot_change_the_weights). The initial-access manifest accepts the FINANCE role (platform contract, additive). The registered profile differs from 0041's only by that bundle (unit test), so it is a widening the 0036 compatibility rule admits; existing tenants keep their ceilings and get the FINANCE role template only through the reviewed access upgrade, and initial-access requests pending at deployment fail ACCESS_PROFILE_CHANGED and must be proposed again. Tenant isolation is unchanged (TH01). Residual: FINANCE now sees AI planning content (plans, advice it is party to) beyond the ranking, because capabilities are not per screen; the owner accepted read-only access.
